blocks.text: Nearly three decades into his career, Filipino rapper Gloc-9 is bringing some of his most memorable songs together in a format that lets listeners revisit his music in a different way. At a vinyl launch in Quezon City on October 23, Gloc-9 celebrated his 29th year in the music industry with ‘Mga Ani ni Gloc-9,’ his first-ever vinyl record produced by Universal Records. The limited-edition release features 11 tracks from different record labels throughout his career, bringing together songs that have helped establish his place in Philippine music.
